newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VENEZUELA ADMITTED TO OVERPRODUCING-GULF SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA ADMITTED TO OVERPRODUCING-GULF SOURCE.

text.p: Venezuela admitted at the OPEC talks here to producing 800,000 barrels per day (bpd) above its quota, a Gulf source said.
The Latin American country said it would "try to" commit to its 2.359 million bpd quota, the source added.
Venezuelan oil minister Erwin Arrieta has consistently denied allegations of overproduction.
"They said they will try to commit themselves to that (their quota)," the Gulf source said.

The Gulf source said that a number of OPEC countries had admitted to producing above their official OPEC allocations. He said only three Gulf countries -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates -- plus Libya and Indonesia had not confessed to some degree of quota violation.
Algeria was not represented at ministerial level.
"What is new is the complete honesty. All of the cheaters made confessions," the Gulf source said.
"I see sufficient evidence that something will be done by each country which is overproducing to make the price go higher," the Gulf source added.
